description: Security and privacy functional requirements, strength requirements, assurance requirements, and security-related documentation requirements are not included in system acquisition contracts.
applicability: This signal applies to: Cloud Service Providers seeking FedRAMP authorization Federal agencies using cloud services Third-party assessment organizations (3PAOs) Systems processing federal information

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for acquisition contracts lacking security requirements, missing privacy functional requirements, absence of security documentation clauses, inadequate security assurance criteria, missing strength of mechanism specifications, lack of supply chain risk management provisions, and incomplete responsibility allocation in contracts.
